note.question: How should multimodal dynamic be priced?
note.overview: The model considers a single product dynamic pricing with demand learning. The candidate prices belong to a wide range of a price interval; the modeling of the demand functions is nonparametric in nature, imposing only smoothness regularity conditions. One important aspect of our model is the possibility of the expected reward function to be nonconcave and indeed multimodal, which leads to many conceptual and technical challenges.
